hypothesis: Constrain correction states/noise/velocity to train-only128D residual subspace while preserving full current conditioning and fixed posterior z. Tests prediction-space dimensionality, not IDM code width.
primary: Original768D feature MSE at fixed400, direct vs flow sample and mean4. Compare both to existing full-space same-seed400 endpoints. No best-of-N.
geometry: Uncentered train-only second moment of future-baseline; no whitening/mean offset. Input current/baseline remain768D, all trainable layers same as full-space controls; projected velocity and state correction rank128. No inference target supplied.
loss: Direct original-space MSE = projected error plus fixed discarded error. Flow velocity MSE in original768D coordinates, projected teacher endpoint; preserves loss scale rather than dividing by128.
noise_caveat: Projected standard Gaussian has same .1 coordinate std within orthonormal128D space, lower total noise energy than original768D flow. Thus a single-sample gain alone does not isolate learnability; mean4 and projected direct comparisons required. No claim of lower FLOPs since wide network is retained.
scope: Train128-basis rank prespecified before evaluation in prepare protocol; basis fit uses512pairs. Evaluations dev64/observed96 already research-observed; posterior reconstruction only. Single seed feasibility, no novelty or held-out final-test claim.
gate: Rank128 oracle floor .02474 on observed96 below direct .08557, so expression floor does not preclude gain. Oracle is not predicted accuracy; all ranks logged, none chosen by eval.
checks: 3 unit tests passed: full-rank old flow equivalence; confined generated corrections and orthogonal MSE decomposition; invalid basis rejection.
reference_limits: Not reproduction of nonlinear VAE/RLA methods; VFMF explicitly finds PCA inferior. Fixed linear subspace is a cheap controlled geometry test.
